zh.headline: Google 新注意力机制提速 3 倍
headline_alt: DeepCrossAttention 让 Transformer 训练更快
效率重新成为模型竞争焦点
zh.observation: 今天最实在的信号来自架构层：Google 的 DeepCrossAttention 与腾讯 DFly2 都指向同一件事——效率重新成为模型竞争的主战场，而非单纯堆参数。与此同时，OpenAI 的 Athena 语义层与 Amazon/Meta 的 Muse 谈判说明，Agent 的瓶颈正从模型能力转向数据定义与商业准入规则。另一条值得警惕的线索是“Markdown 规则文件不是防火墙”的研究：Agent 治理需要真正的门禁，而不是一页说明。JEPA 路线获得三项研究支撑，则提示非 LLM 的具身智能路径正在积累可信证据。

items.title: Google DeepCrossAttention 实现同等质量下最高 3 倍加速
items.desc: Google Research 发布新的残差连接设计，通过跨层注意力复用显著缩短 Transformer 训练与推理时间，模型质量与原架构持平。
items.value: 直接影响训练成本与推理延迟，架构层面可迁移至现有模型

items.title: OpenAI 起诉 Apple，指控窃取商业机密并胁迫共同供应商
items.desc: OpenAI 在加州法院提起反诉，称 Apple 窃取商业机密、向双方共用的供应商施压；两家公司两年前还合作将 ChatGPT 引入 iPhone，如今 OpenAI 自建硬件直接对标 Apple。
items.value: AI 硬件供应链格局生变，合作方需重估与两家的绑定关系

items.title: 被禁 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片现身上海数据中心
items.desc: 据 Bloomberg 调查，两家中国公司将 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片装入上海一处与 Alice Huang 关联的数据中心，序列号指向台湾厂商 Gigabyte；无美国许可对华出口此类芯片属违法。
items.value: 出口管制执行漏洞曝光，算力供应链合规风险上升

items.title: OpenAI 打造 “Athena” 数据平台，减少 AI Agent 猜测
items.desc: ChatGPT Work 中的数据 Agent 准确率仍不足，OpenAI 以 Athena 为代号构建语义层，为 Agent 提供标准化的业务指标定义，可能直接与 Snowflake、Databricks 竞争。
items.value: 语义层成为 Agent 落地企业数据的关键基础设施

items.title: Amazon 与 Meta 洽谈解除对 AI Agent Muse 的封锁
items.desc: 双方讨论允许 Meta 的 Muse Agent 在 Amazon 商城购物，焦点在于 Agent 推荐哪些商品以及对 Amazon 广告收入的影响。
items.value: Agent 电商的准入规则将决定下一代流量入口归属

items.title: Anthropic CEO 回应股价破发与用户抱怨
items.desc: 面对 IPO 后股价破发、用户不满与创始人套现质疑，Anthropic CEO 深夜回应称“从没想过让 AI 统治人类”。
items.value: 头部模型公司上市后的舆论与治理压力显性化

items.title: SAP 拟裁减至少 1 万人转向 AI
items.desc: 据 Bloomberg 报道，SAP 正推进大规模 AI 重组，至少 1 万个岗位将被裁撤。
items.value: 企业软件巨头用 AI 重构组织，波及大量传统 IT 岗位

items.title: JioHotstar 实测：给编码 Agent 加知识库反而更费 Token
items.desc: 该团队测试六种方案后发现，文件搜索在成本与效果上依然最有竞争力，知识库方案并未带来预期收益。
items.value: 为 Agent 上下文工程提供反直觉的实证参考

items.title: Meta 与 AMI Labs 三项研究支持 LeCun 的 JEPA 世界模型路线
items.desc: 三项新研究分别在机器人规划、更高效训练与错误纠正上取得进展，为以内部世界模型替代大语言模型的路线提供实证支撑，但各模块仍需整合。
items.value: 非 LLM 路线的关键验证，影响具身智能架构选型

items.title: DAWIN：面向连续时间时空学习的通用神经元原语
items.desc: 该研究提出阻尼原子波积分神经元，将空间投影与依赖经过时间的波激励耦合，以闭式阻尼演化维护局部复数状态，可替换 MLP、Transformer 与 GNN 中的标准神经元层。
items.value: 为不规则采样时序建模提供可插拔的新基础单元

items.title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall：四个编码 Agent、一份规则文件、四道边界
items.desc: 研究用一份 278 词规则文件测试 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 与 OpenCode，在 20 个带隐藏测试的小型仓库上检验规则文件的约束力，发现 Agent 很少主动查阅仓库贡献规则。
items.value: 揭示“规则文件当安全控制”的误区，Agent 治理需真正门禁

items.title: OS-Omni：跨平台长程工作流 Computer-Using Agent 基准
items.desc: 现有基准多隔离 web、移动或桌面环境，OS-Omni 构建实时跨 Windows、Ubuntu 等平台的执行环境，评估单一通用 Agent 能否完成跨系统、带持久应用状态的长程任务。
items.value: 填补跨 OS Agent 评测空白，直指真实用户目标

items.title: DRBench Pro：以知识覆盖为核心的专业深度研究 Agent 基准
items.desc: 该基准以结构化知识覆盖度为首要评估目标，自动化流水线从 Wikipedia 构建本地知识树，衡量报告覆盖了哪些研究方向、探索到多深。
items.value: 为 deep research Agent 提供可量化的知识维度评测

items.title: AI Agent 在数据库犯错时，什么决定损害程度
items.desc: 研究以 22 个典型错误脚本对四种关系型引擎做预注册测试，区分模型、数据库前 guard 层与引擎本身在损害控制中的作用。
items.value: 为生产数据库接入 Agent 的防护设计提供实证依据

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.desc: Google Labs 推出的 Agent Skills 库，配合 Stitch MCP server 使用，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码 Agent。
items.value: 跨 Agent 的技能标准落地，降低多工具迁移成本

items.title: 腾讯开源 DFly2：复用目标模型稀疏 KV Cache 的投机解码
items.desc: 针对稀疏注意力 LLM 的投机解码 drafter，每层复用目标模型的 KV cache 与 top-k indexer 选择，不额外占用 draft KV 内存，64K 上下文服务吞吐最高提升 81%。
items.value: 长上下文推理降本直接可用，无需额外显存

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.desc: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编码 Agent 的图表设计技能库，覆盖 52 种图表类型，输出自包含 HTML + SVG，明确拒绝 Mermaid 式粗糙产出。
items.value: 提升 Agent 生成图表的专业度与可控性

items.title: SessionGraph：把全部编码 Agent 会话可视化为交互图
items.desc: 该工具将多个编码 Agent 的会话统一汇入一张可交互图谱，便于追踪上下文与任务流转。
items.value: 多 Agent 并行开发时的会话管理与复盘工具

items.title: Michael Nielsen 下架其经典教材《Neural Networks and Deep Learning》
items.desc: 该免费在线书多年是入门必读，突然下线在 HN 引发 400+ 点、265 条评论的讨论，社区聚焦于开放教育资源的可持续性与作者意愿。
items.value: 提醒依赖外部免费教材的团队做好知识资产备份

items.title: “P=NP 已被 OpenAI 解决”传闻在 HN 发酵
items.desc: 一则 Twitter 爆料称 P 等于 NP 且由 OpenAI 实验室解决，虽证据薄弱，仍在技术圈引发关于大模型是否可能推动理论计算机科学突破的讨论。
items.value: 反映社区对 AI 科研能力的期待与警惕并存

en.headline: Google's new attention mechanism is 3x faster
headline_alt: Efficiency is back at the center of model competition
en.observation: Today's most substantive signal comes from the architecture layer: Google's DeepCrossAttention and Tencent's DFly2 both point to the same thing—efficiency is once again the main battleground of model competition, rather than simply stacking parameters. Meanwhile, OpenAI's Athena semantic layer and the Amazon/Meta Muse negotiations show that the bottleneck for Agents is shifting from model capability to data definition and commercial access rules. Another thread worth watching is the research finding that "Markdown rule files are not firewalls": Agent governance needs real gates, not a page of instructions. The JEPA line receiving support from three studies suggests that non-LLM embodied intelligence paths are accumulating credible evidence.

items.title: Google DeepCrossAttention achieves up to 3x speedup at equal quality
items.desc: Google Research released a new residual connection design that significantly shortens Transformer training and inference time by reusing cross-layer attention, with model quality on par with the original architecture.
items.value: Directly affects training cost and inference latency; architecture is transferable to existing models

items.title: OpenAI sues Apple, alleging trade secret theft and coercion of shared suppliers
items.desc: OpenAI filed a countersuit in a California court, claiming Apple stole trade secrets and pressured suppliers shared by both companies; two years ago the two companies partnered to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone, and now OpenAI's own hardware directly targets Apple.
items.value: AI hardware supply chain landscape shifts; partners must reassess ties to both companies

items.title: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips surface in a Shanghai data center
items.desc: According to a Bloomberg investigation, two Chinese companies installed Nvidia Blackwell chips in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, with serial numbers pointing to Taiwanese manufacturer Gigabyte; exporting such chips to China without a US license is illegal.
items.value: Export control enforcement gaps exposed; compliance risk rises across compute supply chains

items.title: OpenAI builds "Athena" data platform to reduce AI Agent guesswork
items.desc: Data Agents in ChatGPT Work still fall short on accuracy, so OpenAI is building a semantic layer codenamed Athena to give Agents standardized business metric definitions, potentially competing directly with Snowflake and Databricks.
items.value: Semantic layers become key infrastructure for Agents to access enterprise data

items.title: Amazon and Meta in talks to lift block on AI Agent Muse
items.desc: The two sides are discussing allowing Meta's Muse Agent to shop on Amazon's marketplace, with the focus on which products the Agent recommends and the impact on Amazon's ad revenue.
items.value: Agent commerce access rules will determine who owns the next-generation traffic gateway

items.title: Anthropic CEO responds to below-IPO-price stock and user complaints
items.desc: Facing a share price below its IPO price, user dissatisfaction, and questions over founders cashing out, Anthropic's CEO responded late at night saying he "never wanted AI to rule humanity."
items.value: Public opinion and governance pressure on top model companies after going public becomes visible

items.title: SAP plans to cut at least 10,000 jobs in shift to AI
items.desc: According to Bloomberg, SAP is pushing a large-scale AI restructuring in which at least 10,000 positions will be eliminated.
items.value: Enterprise software giant restructures around AI, hitting many traditional IT roles

items.title: JioHotstar test: adding a knowledge base to coding Agents actually costs more tokens
items.desc: After testing six approaches, the team found file search remains the most competitive on cost and effectiveness, and the knowledge base approach did not deliver the expected benefits.
items.value: Provides counterintuitive empirical reference for Agent context engineering

items.title: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs support LeCun's JEPA world model路线
items.desc: Three new studies make progress on robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, providing empirical support for the路线 of replacing large language models with internal world models, though the modules still need to be integrated.
items.value: Key validation of the non-LLM路线, influencing embodied AI architecture choices

items.title: DAWIN: A general neuron primitive for continuous-time spatiotemporal learning
items.desc: The study proposes the damped atomic wave integral neuron, which couples spatial projection with wave excitation that depends on elapsed time and maintains local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, and can replace standard neuron layers in MLPs, Transformers, and GNNs.
items.value: Provides a pluggable new building block for irregularly sampled time-series modeling

items.title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: Four coding agents, one rules file, four boundaries
items.desc: The study uses a 278-word rules file to test Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode across 20 small repositories with hidden tests to examine how binding the rules file is, finding that agents rarely proactively consult repository contribution rules.
items.value: Reveals the misconception of treating rules files as security controls; agent governance needs real gates

items.title: OS-Omni: A cross-platform long-horizon workflow Computer-Using Agent benchmark
items.desc: Existing benchmarks mostly isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, whereas OS-Omni builds a live execution environment spanning Windows, Ubuntu, and other platforms to evaluate whether a single general-purpose agent can complete cross-system, long-horizon tasks with persistent application state.
items.value: Fills the gap in cross-OS agent evaluation and targets real user goals

items.title: DRBench Pro: A professional deep research agent benchmark centered on knowledge coverage
items.desc: This benchmark takes structured knowledge coverage as its primary evaluation target; an automated pipeline builds a local knowledge tree from Wikipedia to measure which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them.
items.value: Provides quantifiable knowledge-dimension evaluation for deep research agents

items.title: When AI agents make mistakes in databases, what determines the extent of damage
items.desc: The study conducts preregistered tests on four relational engines using 22 typical error scripts, distinguishing the roles of the model, the database pre-guard layer, and the engine itself in damage control.
items.value: Provides empirical evidence for protection design when connecting agents to production databases

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.desc: An Agent Skills library from Google Labs, used with the Stitch MCP server, following the open Agent Skills standard and compatible with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.
items.value: A cross-agent skill standard lands, cutting multi-tool migration costs

items.title: Tencent open-sources DFly2: speculative decoding that reuses the target model's sparse KV cache
items.desc: A speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs that reuses the target model's KV cache and top-k indexer selection at every layer, adding no extra draft KV memory and raising serving throughput by up to 81% at 64K context.
items.value: Long-context inference cost cuts usable now, with no extra VRAM

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.desc: A diagram design skill library for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, covering 52 diagram types and outputting self-contained HTML + SVG, explicitly rejecting crude Mermaid-style output.
items.value: Raises the professionalism and controllability of agent-generated diagrams

items.title: SessionGraph: visualizing all coding agent sessions as an interactive graph
items.desc: The tool funnels sessions from multiple coding agents into one interactive graph, making it easy to track context and task flow.
items.value: A session management and review tool for parallel multi-agent development

items.title: Michael Nielsen takes down his classic textbook "Neural Networks and Deep Learning"
items.desc: The free online book, a must-read for beginners for years, was suddenly taken offline, sparking a 400+ point, 265-comment discussion on HN focused on the sustainability of open educational resources and the author's wishes.
items.value: A reminder for teams relying on external free textbooks to back up knowledge assets

items.title: "P=NP has been solved by OpenAI" rumor gains traction on HN
items.desc: A Twitter tip claimed P equals NP and that it was solved by an OpenAI lab; despite thin evidence, it still sparked discussion in tech circles about whether large models could drive breakthroughs in theoretical computer science.
items.value: Reflects the community's mixed expectation and wariness toward AI research capability
